rationale: Satisfies AC3 for any consuming-project layout with zero per-project setup, reusing an already-idiomatic **/x/** glob token; Option B keeps a hardcoded literal and requires manual settings.json edits per project, contradicting this codebase's zero-config design goal with no existing precedent.
rule: Option A — widen allowed-tools to Write(**/spike/**) / Edit(**/spike/**)
alternatives_rejected: Option B: keep project-specific static glob, document a .claude/settings.json override for consuming projects
